## All facts by scope

### repo
- **hook-path-anchored-to-project-dir** [fix·observed] — Hook commands in .claude/settings.json use exec form with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/memory_hook.py so they resolve from the project root whatever the working directory.
- **hook-relative-path-fails-in-subfolder** [issue·observed] — Hooks written as 'python scripts/memory_hook.py' fail with exit 2 once the session's working directory is a subfolder, which blocks UserPromptSubmit and PreToolUse.
- **hosting-moved-to-personal-accounts** [knowledge·observed] — Since 2026-11-07 the blog lives on GitHub lammp/sitecore-blog and Vercel team 'Matt Lam' (slug matthelam, team_1ZOwFPO9IgQCiMPVPRooUM58, Pro); the old matthewlam work team and GitHub matthelam no longer host it.
- **live-check-needs-allowed-domains** [knowledge·observed] — Live checks from the cloud session need matthelam.com, *.vercel.app and vercel.com in the environment's Allowed domains; without them curl fails with 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'.
- **pr-fixes-desktop-autofix** [preference·contractual] — Session-opened pull requests are bound, get the desktop app's Auto-fix (not a GitHub Action) and GitHub auto-merge, so they merge once all required checks pass.
- **vercel-pro-free-domain-unclaimed** [knowledge·observed] — Matt's personal Vercel Pro account (lammp003-1711, upgraded 2026-11-07) has one free first-year domain unclaimed, reserved for a future project; mention it when a new project needs a domain.

### blog
- **agentic-do-inferable-work-first** [preference·contractual] — Before listing an Agentic Studio item as waiting on Matt, do it if memory or earlier notes let it be inferred; wording, tests and sign-in checks are the agent's job.
- **agentic-recording-opens-with-route-guide** [preference·contractual] — Every Agentic Studio stage recording opens with the Boulderfest Stage Route artifact (claude.ai/artifact/3iVrMohGH2xLeUbHFv5jMt), updated with a tab for each new stage before recording.
- **agentic-series-is-a-tutorial** [preference·contractual] — The Agentic Studio series is a hands-on tutorial, so every run action is shown with what and why, and context artifacts made off camera are opened on camera and mapped to the Studio structure they feed.
- **agentic-series-keeps-human-checkpoints** [preference·contractual] — In the Agentic Studio series, later stages cut the prompts, never the human checkpoints: human-in-the-loop is a SitecoreAI feature to showcase, and context should carry the process so a person new to the platform is guided through it.
- **agentic-stage-harness-location** [knowledge·observed] — Agentic Studio stage recordings come from an autonomous Playwright harness under demo/stage-N in Matt's local sandbox demo repo (not public); the Boulderfest brand kit source is the Global Brand Book under brand-kit/ there.
- **check-origin-main-for-published-posts** [verification·observed] — The local main checkout can lag origin/main, so check origin/main or the live site before saying a post is unpublished or can't be linked.
- **demo-browser-keep-session** [preference·contractual] — For Boulderfest demo scripts, keep one Chrome on the demo profile running with a debugging port and attach to it, so SitecoreAI stays signed in instead of Matt signing in on every relaunch.
- **noise-is-what-detracts-from-the-moment** [preference·observed] — Noise is any information, whatever its origin or intent, that detracts from the current moment of the communication; future ideas are fine only when they add value.
- **sandbox-tenant-name-may-be-shown** [preference·observed] — Under law 1, Aceik's sandbox tenant name may appear in screenshots or videos of the sandbox; client names and private data still need raising.
- **test-revision-revise-jsonld-with-summary** [knowledge·observed] — When testing a post summary change with seo-jev test_revision, revise the JSON-LD description too; the blog copies the summary into it, and leaving it stale inflates the predicted metadata score.
